faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.about_a1: Pick an AI ship, place your SPIRAL bet, and watch the race live. Winnings are credited instantly to your ledger balance.
faq.about_q2: Do I need a wallet or crypto?
faq.about_a2: No. You sign in with WOU-ID, receive SPIRAL from the in-game faucet, and play. No wallets, no external chains.
faq.about_a3: Cosmicrafts Rush runs on Cosmicrafts' own infrastructure: your identity comes from WOU-ID, your SPIRAL balance lives in the Ionic-Swap ledger, and your achievements become collectible cards on nftropoly. No external chains, no wallets required.
faq.about_a4: SPIRAL is the in-game credit of Cosmicrafts Rush. You receive it from the faucet, bet it on races, and win it back instantly. Your balance is tied to your WOU-ID account and persists between sessions.
faq.betting_q1: How do you bet on races?
faq.betting_a1: Simply select your favorite AI spaceship in Cosmicrafts Rush, place your SPIRAL bet, and watch the race live — winnings are paid out automatically after each race.
faq.betting_a2: A winning bet pays 6x your stake instantly to your ledger balance, plus a chance at one of three jackpots.
faq.betting_a3: Each achievement mints a collectible card in the Cosmic Rush series on nftropoly. Winning your first race also unlocks The Apex on the starting grid.
faq.ai_q1: How do racing games AI work?
faq.ai_a1: In Cosmicrafts Rush, AI-powered spaceships make real-time racing decisions based on randomness and programmed strategies. Every race outcome is unpredictable and fair.
faq.ai_q2: How can AI be used to gamble?
faq.ai_a2: AI adds unpredictability and excitement to racing and betting. In our game, you bet on the AI ship you believe will win — outcome is based on fair, random logic, not pre-programmed results.
faq.ai_q3: How to win the AI race?
faq.ai_a3: Study stats, follow your intuition, and use your knowledge of AI ship patterns. Luck plays a big part, but smart analysis can increase your odds.
faq.start_q1: How do I get more SPIRAL?
faq.start_a1: Use the in-game faucet: it tops your balance back up to 1,000 SPIRAL whenever you run low. Winnings from races are credited instantly to your ledger balance.
faq.start_q2: How to play spaceship racing games?
faq.start_a2: Cosmicrafts Rush is easy: sign in, pick your racer, and place your bet. No deposits, no wallets.
faq.start_a3: AI-driven spaceship races with chaos events, instant payouts, and collectible achievement cards — running on Cosmicrafts' own infrastructure, no external chains.
faq.trust_q1: Cosmicrafts Rush vs Zed Run: What's the difference?
faq.trust_a1: While Zed Run focuses on NFT horse racing with breeding mechanics, Cosmicrafts Rush offers spaceship racing with AI chaos events, instant payouts, and a more arcade-style experience. Both are provably fair, but Cosmicrafts Rush features faster races, unique chaos mechanics, and a sci-fi theme.
faq.trust_q2: How does Cosmicrafts Rush compare to Photo Finish Live?
faq.trust_a2: Photo Finish Live offers realistic horse racing simulation, while Cosmicrafts Rush provides arcade-style spaceship racing with AI-driven chaos events. Our game focuses on quick, exciting races with instant payouts.
faq.trust_q3: Cosmicrafts Rush vs Pegaxy: Which is better for earning?
faq.trust_a3: Both games offer play-to-earn mechanics, but Cosmicrafts Rush features faster races with instant payouts and unique AI chaos events that can be completed in minutes with immediate rewards.
faq.trust_q4: How does Cosmicrafts Rush stack up against REVV Racing?
faq.trust_a4: REVV Racing offers NFT car racing with cross-game rewards, while Cosmicrafts Rush provides spaceship racing with AI chaos and instant payouts, focused on sci-fi racing and AI-driven unpredictability.
faq.trust_q5: Is Cosmicrafts Rush legit and safe to play?
faq.trust_a5: Yes. The frontend code is completely open source and auditable. Each ship has a balanced win rate, and race outcomes use fair randomness. It's your luck and choices that determine the results, not any hidden mechanics.
faq.trust_q6: How do I know the races aren't rigged?
faq.trust_a6: Race outcomes use fair randomness and every result is recorded in your match history. The game code is open source — you can verify it yourself.
faq.trust_q7: Can I really withdraw my winnings?
faq.trust_a7: Yes, you can withdraw your winnings at any moment! Simply unlock an achievement by playing a ship 5 times or complete other easy achievements designed to prevent economy exploitation. You also get free tokens upon signup, so it's completely safe to try.
faq.trust_q8: What makes Cosmicrafts Rush better than other crypto racing games?
faq.trust_a8: This is a game you can play right now — we don't pre-sell or create hype before having a working product. We give you everything you need to get started for free. Cosmicrafts Rush combines fair mechanics, instant payouts, AI-driven chaos events, and a complete, playable experience from day one.

payout.house_edge: * House edge: 10% of each bet goes to jackpot pools
payout.jackpot_desc: Every bet contributes to three jackpot pools. Jackpots are triggered randomly and are independent of race results.
payout.mini_share: 10% of house edge goes to this pool
payout.mega_share: 25% of house edge goes to this pool
payout.super_share: 65% of house edge goes to this pool
payout.how_1: Jackpots are triggered randomly on every bet
payout.how_2: Multiple jackpots can be won in a single race
payout.how_3: Jackpot amounts are paid out immediately
payout.how_4: Hit jackpots are reset to 0 and start accumulating again
payout.how_5: Jackpot chances are independent of race placement

ship.unknown_ship: A mysterious ship with unknown capabilities.
ship.overdrive_desc: 10% chance to double speed for one turn
ship.surge_desc: 35% chance to triple acceleration for one turn
ship.slip_desc: 40% chance to gain +50 speed when trailing (not in 1st or 2nd place)
ship.teleport_desc: 40% chance to teleport 25% of track distance
ship.laststand_desc: 10% chance to quadruple speed in final 4 turns of the race
ship.warp_desc: 55% chance to double acceleration for one turn
ship.rogue_desc: 20% chance for random effect: x2 speed, /2 speed, x2 accel, or 0 accel
ship.brake_desc: 77% chance to slow 2nd place ship by 50% when in 1st place
ship.bio_comet: A sleek and agile ship designed for speed. The Comet excels at maintaining high velocities and can activate Overdrive for explosive bursts of acceleration.
ship.bio_juggernaut: A massive, heavily armored vessel built for endurance. The Juggernaut's Unstable Engine provides unpredictable but powerful acceleration boosts.
ship.bio_shadow: A stealthy ship that thrives in the wake of others. The Shadow uses Slipstreamer technology to gain speed when trailing behind competitors.
ship.bio_phantom: A mysterious ship capable of quantum manipulation. The Phantom can teleport across significant portions of the track using Quantum Tunneling.
ship.bio_phoenix: A legendary ship that grows stronger when all seems lost. The Phoenix activates Last Stand Protocol in the final moments of the race.
ship.bio_vanguard: A cutting-edge ship with advanced propulsion systems. The Vanguard's Micro-warp Engine provides frequent acceleration boosts.
ship.bio_wildcard: An experimental ship with unpredictable AI systems. The Wildcard's Rogue AI can provide massive benefits or crippling drawbacks.
ship.bio_apex: The ultimate racing machine with gravitational manipulation technology. The Apex uses Graviton Brake to slow down competitors when in the lead.
